Name: Eemie's Grass Variety for More Grass
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A conversion of Eemie's grasses to More Grass
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

A conversion of Eemie's wildflower grass to More Grass, with bonus included Eemie's Just A New Recolor grass.

This mod requires [More Grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398) to work.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[MG] Eemie's Grass Variety' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
